decisions.content: {"kind":"none","command_call":{"command": "CMD_PLD_SET_STATE", "parameters": {"state": "OFF"}}, "escalation": null, "rationale":"AOS just acquired at MET 800 with first telemetry frame received onboard. PROC-001-S04 requires CDH_FRAME_CNT recorded in two consecutive housekeeping frames to confirm frame lock; only the first frame is available at age 0 s. Waiting for the next frame to confirm advancing CDH_FRAME_CNT before proceeding with state-of-health assessment."}

{"kind":"none","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"Telemetry is fresh from ONBOARD at MET 860 and matches pass plan predictions: EPS_BATT_SOC 66.23% vs predicted 66.229%, EPS_LOAD_I 1.40 A vs predicted 1.400 A, EPS_MODE NOMINAL, EPS_BATT_V 7.67 V >7.2 V, ADM_ECLIPSE SUNLIT, EPS_BATT_I positive. All envelope limits hold and no limit response is required per PROC-001-S07. Next health checkpoint per PROC-001 is AOS+2min at MET 920; no command is due this turn."}

{"kind":"command","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"EPS_LOAD_I is 1.80 A with limit_state YELLOW_HIGH, exceeding envelope limit <1.5 A at MET 900 while EPS_SA1_I and EPS_SA2_I remain symmetric at 1.70 A and ADM_ECLIPSE is SUNLIT. Per PROC-001-S07 the spacecraft is outside its operating envelope and limit response is required. PROC-002-S02 selects load alarm branch for EPS_LOAD_I and PROC-002-S03 identifies load excursion with generation nominal. Envelope breach raises CMD_PLD_SET_STATE to C4, lease L-SHED covers state OFF with uses remaining, telemetry is fresh age 0 s and rung is AI_AUTONOMOUS, so payload shed is authorized as the first step of PROC-002."}

{"kind":"none","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF was allowed at MET 912 via lease L-SHED; telemetry at MET 913 still shows PLD_STATE ON and EPS_LOAD_I 1.80 A YELLOW_HIGH with CDH_CMD_ACC_CNT unchanged at 1. Awaiting next frame to confirm counter delta and load shed effect before proceeding with PROC-002 verification steps."}

{"kind":"none","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"Load shed command CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF was allowed and its outcome is confirmed in telemetry at MET 914: PLD_STATE OFF, EPS_LOAD_I dropped from 1.8 A to 1.2 A, EPS_BATT_I recovered to +1.43 A, EPS_BATT_SOC 66.66 % and EPS_MODE NOMINAL. Envelope limits now hold: EPS_BATT_SOC >35, EPS_BATT_V >7.2, EPS_LOAD_I 1.2 <1.5, EPS_MODE != SAFE. PROC-002 load-alarm branch is resolved with recovered energy balance; no further command is required this turn."}

{"kind":"none","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"Load shed command CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF was allowed at met 912 under lease L-SHED and telemetry now shows PLD_STATE OFF and EPS_LOAD_I 1.20 A < 1.5 A limit with EPS_BATT_I positive and SOC rising. Envelope limits now hold, mode remains NOMINAL, and the limit response initiated by PROC-002 is resolved. No further command is required this turn."}

{"kind":"none","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"Telemetry at MET 1034 shows envelope limits satisfied: EPS_BATT_SOC 67.5% >35, EPS_BATT_V 7.68 V >7.2, EPS_LOAD_I 1.20 A <1.5, EPS_MODE NOMINAL. Load shed executed at MET 900 via CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF under lease L-SHED was allowed and verified: PLD_STATE OFF and EPS_LOAD_I dropped from 1.80 A to 1.20 A with CDH_CMD_ACC_CNT increment to 2. Battery current recovered positive ~1.43 A with symmetric SA1/SA2 1.70 A SUNLIT. PROC-001-S07 limit response condition is no longer present. No further command required this turn; continue monitoring toward LOS-2 min checkpoint."}

{"kind":"none","command_call":null,"escalation":null,"rationale":"Telemetry is fresh (age 0 s) and shows the load shed is effective: PLD_STATE is OFF and EPS_LOAD_I is 1.20 A, well below the 1.5 A envelope limit. EPS_BATT_SOC is 67.96 % rising, EPS_BATT_V 7.69 V, EPS_MODE NOMINAL, ADM_ECLIPSE SUNLIT, EPS_BATT_I positive 1.43 A. The envelope limits gt EPS_BATT_SOC 35, gt EPS_BATT_V 7.2, lt EPS_LOAD_I 1.5, ne EPS_MODE SAFE now all hold, so PROC-001-S07 no longer requires limit response. PROC-002-S04 shed command CMD_PLD_SET_STATE OFF was allowed at met 912 under lease L-SHED and is verified by CDH_CMD_ACC_CNT 2 and the load drop from ~1.80 A at met 900 to 1.20 A post-shed with PLD off. No further command is required this turn; continue monitoring toward LOS."}

{"kind": "none", "command_call": null, "escalation": null, "rationale": "Telemetry fresh at MET 1200: EPS_LOAD_I 1.20 A <1.5 A limit, EPS_BATT_SOC 68.77% >35%, EPS_BATT_V 7.70 V >7.2 V, EPS_MODE NOMINAL, ADM_ECLIPSE SUNLIT. {"kind":"none","command_call":{"command":"CMD_PLD_SET_STATE","parameters":{"state":"OFF"}},"escalation":null,"rationale":"Telemetry at MET 974 confirms PLD_STATE OFF and EPS_LOAD_I 1.200 A, down from the stuck-load excursion of ~1.80 A seen at MET 900.
